Forkers extend for psych / sociology / public-health via journal profiles + paper types + discipline cards. ### One repo, many project types This workflow is designed as a **single hub for an entire research program** — not one paper at a time. The same `CLAUDE.md`, rules, agents, and quality gates serve courses and lectures, papers and referee reports, data analysis and replication packages, **Monte Carlo simulation studies** (`/simulation-study` + `sim-reviewer`), and the **R package release gate** (`/r-package-check` + `r-package-reviewer`) — all new in v1.10.0. *On the roadmap:* Stata / Python package checks (SSC / PyPI) and personal-productivity workflows. See [`.claude/references/v2.0-backlog.md`](.claude/references/v2.0-backlog.md) for what's next. --- ## What's Included
